study.question: Does the buy task still make a useful contribution through shared context in the current block-projected unified model, and is its tiny summary-direction difference sensitive to that route? Observation: r0070 restored/native click AUC is 0.6685318110053072/0.6685268680116033 (difference0.0000049429937039), while buy AUC is 0.8280781401562641/0.8304986712266874. Identical same-seed bridges do not establish robustness or useful benefit. Earlier r0033 all-aux versus cart/fav-only and r0044 all-product versus cart/fav-only favored retaining buy context, but those are different architectures, not matched current controls.
study.hypothesis: Buy history-projection updates can affect click through subsequent shared-context learning even though auxiliary history/item/scorer inputs are detached. Removing every buy-to-context gradient edge should reduce click AUC under both native and restored summary VJPs if that route remains useful. The buy summary-direction intervention itself is provisionally near-neutral for click and harmful for buy quality. Global dense clipping is a surviving coupling when context is isolated; no direct projection-to-shared-item-gradient mechanism is claimed.

study.proposed_difference: A two-new-cell continuation of a2x2: buy context transfer live/isolated crossed with buy summary VJP native/removed_restored. New isolated cells detach adapter_context for label buy before both the residual adapter and context query; buy tower context is already detached. Buy private parameters and loss remain active. Live cells are the frozen r0070 receipts, so this is not four new runs. No added parameters/buffers, labels in forward, capacity, RNG or host recipe change. The model exposes a live override solely for parity preflight.
predictions: At common nonzero model state, all four forward predictions and buffers are identical for live/isolated; isolated buy has no direct shared-embedding/scorer gradient, but its private gradients remain equal before global clipping.

Single-seed descriptive prediction: native_live-native_isolated and restored_live-restored_isolated click AUC each exceed0.0001 if buy context transfer remains useful. This is a prospective practical decision margin, not a significance threshold.

Report delta_live=0.0000049429937039, delta_isolated=restored_isolated-native_isolated and their difference I=delta_live-delta_isolated. The small live total effect makes mediation attribution exploratory even if I is nonzero.

Parameter counts should remain32192421 total/31793216 embedding/399205 dense. New runs should cost near the r0070 roughly400-second wall receipts; measure actual cost, do not claim an efficiency improvement from detaching alone.
A buy-isolated restored/native click difference may survive via global dense clipping or numerical effects; zero direct shared gradient does not predict exactly equal trained click models.
falsifiers: If either isolated cell retains a direct buy gradient to shared embeddings/scorer, or forward/state/RNG parity fails, the isolation implementation is invalid and performance cannot answer the mechanism question.

If isolation preserves or improves click within the0.0001 descriptive margin under both VJPs, useful buy-context transfer is unsupported in this implementation; earlier architectures do not rescue the claim.

If restored still produces a comparable click difference under isolation, the shared-context-only explanation of that difference is unsupported. Conversely disappearance alone does not prove mediation because the live difference is tiny and nonlinear clipping remains.

No benefit or originality claim follows from one fixed seed, deterministic same-seed reruns or many validation selections. Restored summary routing is not promoted on a0.00000494 click gain while buy quality degrades without paired uncertainty evidence.
alternative_explanations: Global dense clipping still couples otherwise private buy gradients to shared dense updates; the host clip stays frozen and no clipping diagnostics are assumed available.
Changed private buy parameters affect later losses/gradients and clipping; isolating a route changes an optimization trajectory rather than identifying a natural indirect causal effect.
Fixed seed, repeated validation selection and floating-point effects can explain tiny rank differences. Existing bridges repeat one initialization, not independent mechanism evidence.
Local node norm matching does not match parameter-gradient norms, optimizer steps or clipping multipliers; changes in buy AUC can reflect optimization rather than preserved historical signal.
Historical action visibility and publisher vocab/static snapshots are inherited offline assumptions; auxiliary labels are user/category/brand24h matches, not advertisement conversion attribution.
